environment.description: ECS Fargate service with task role 'arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/tenant-scoped-app-role'. The role's DynamoDB policy uses dynamodb:LeadingKeys condition with ForAllValues:StringLike comparator, bound to the ECS task's tag 'tenant_prefix' injected via taskRoleArn session tags from the OIDC provider trust policy. Additionally, a Service Control Policy (SCP) at the OU level enforces a Deny with StringNotLike on dynamodb:LeadingKeys for any principal not matching the session tag pattern '${aws:PrincipalTag/tenant_id}/*'. The table has a partition key format of '{tenant_id}/resource/{uuid}'. Note: the SCP uses a Deny-with-NotCondition pattern which inverts the logic — it denies DynamoDB write/read actions UNLESS the leading key matches the caller's session-tagged tenant_id. The OIDC provider's trust policy includes a Condition block that maps the 'sub' claim to 'aws:PrincipalTag/tenant_id' via sts:TagSession, ensuring the session tag is immutable and derived from the identity token.
